name: 30189 · Woodstock, GA
findings: ZIP 30189 (Woodstock) has 107 nonprofit organizations. 38 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 25 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 30189 (Woodstock) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
37% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 30189 (Woodstock) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 57% of the typical level).
